# A repo may set conflict-marker-size below git's default of 7. The markers the
# secret driver writes into the revealed plaintext are produced by us, so we clamp
# %L to the size the conflict scanners look for - otherwise short markers would be
# invisible to them and get sealed into the object on the next finalize.

sesam-repo admin base.txt ours.txt theirs.txt

cp $TMPDIR/base.txt db.txt
exec sesam add db.txt --group admin
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'add db'

# Ask git for 3-character conflict markers on the sesam objects.
exec sh -c 'echo ".sesam/objects/**/*.sesam conflict-marker-size=3" >> .gitattributes'
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'small conflict markers'

exec git checkout -b ours
cp $TMPDIR/ours.txt db.txt
exec sesam seal
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'ours'

exec git checkout -b theirs ours~1
cp $TMPDIR/theirs.txt db.txt
exec sesam seal
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'theirs'

exec git checkout ours
! exec git merge theirs
stderr 'automatically merging revealed file db.txt; 1 conflict - please fix manually'

# Full-length markers despite the attribute, so the scanners still see them.
grep '^<<<<<<< ' db.txt
grep '^>>>>>>> ' db.txt

exec sesam status
stdout 'conflicted'

exec git add -A
! exec git commit --no-edit
stderr 'unresolved conflicts in this merge'

-- base.txt --
line1
SECRET = BASE
line3
-- ours.txt --
line1
SECRET = OURS
line3
-- theirs.txt --
line1
SECRET = THEIRS
line3
